title: Drum mask config (drums MVP)
description: Config for overlay user one-shot at each detected kick/hats hit onto the drums stem

one_shot_path.description: Path to canonical user one-shot (e.g. canonical/canonical.mp3 from ingest)

drum_events.description: Merged list of hit times (seconds). Built by build_drum_placements.py from kick_times.csv + hats_times.csv

duck_original_db.description: Optional duck original drums at hit times (dB). 0 = no ducking
